A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, Efficient Learning with Sine-Activated Low-Rank Matrices. All 22 pages of each version, including equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A.1–A.2.5, support reliable comparison without material gaps.

before.justification: v2 reports original experiments on language-model adaptation, image classification, NeRF reconstruction, and 3D occupancy modeling, with additional results and ablations in Appendix A.2.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results in Section 4 and Appendix A.2, including the authors' sine LoRA, sine DoRA, classification, and reconstruction experiments.

M1.justification: The sine transformation of low-rank matrix products, frequency and gain parameters, and adaptations to LoRA, DoRA, and other architectures are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix A.2.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same GLUE and commonsense reasoning tasks, CIFAR-100, ImageNet-1k, LLFF scenes, and Thai Statue, Lucy, and Dragon occupancy reconstruction. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: LoRA in Tables 1–2, DoRA in Table 7, and conventional full-rank and low-rank models in the vision and reconstruction experiments. Figure 3 also retains the same nonlinearity comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix A.2 retain the same model sizes, rank configurations, adapted layers, training budgets, batch sizes, sampling procedures, and evaluation metrics. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The matrix and spectral analyses in Figures 2–3, frequency ablations in Table 10 and Figures 7 and 9, and qualitative reconstruction cases in Figures 5, 6, and 8 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged throughout the main text and appendix. Neither version provides repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical and qualitative results match throughout. For example, rank-4 sine LoRA averages 83.61 in Table 2, and rank-1 sine low-rank NeRF achieves 19.77 mean PSNR in Table 3 in both versions. Appendix scores, ablations, and resource measurements also match.

T1.justification: Section 3.2 and Appendix A.1 retain the same definitions, assumptions, Proposition 1, Theorem 1, two lemmas, and proofs. No mathematical statement or derivation is revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims: sinusoidal activation increases rank without adding trainable parameters and improves low-rank models across the demonstrated applications.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning expressiveness, overfitting, and memorization are unchanged. Section 5 retains the accuracy and overparameterization limitation, while Appendix A.2 retains the qualification that frequency selection lacks a principled rule.

D1.justification: Appendix A.2 retains the same implementation details, frequency and gain choices, learning rates, training schedules, hardware, and computational-cost disclosures. Code and data access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, in-text citations, and the reference list are unchanged. The positioning relative to LoRA, DoRA, and other low-rank and parameter-efficient approaches is also retained.

P1.justification: v4 adds DATA61, CSIRO as an affiliation for Yiping Ji, removes the repeated ICLR 2025 publication header, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific prose, terminology, section order, and appendix organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The additional affiliation causes minor first-page reflow, and the running publication text is removed. Figures 1–9 and Tables 1–13 retain their appearance, captions, and placement; page bodies after the first page are visually identical.

improvement.justification: v4 changes affiliation and publication metadata with minor layout adjustments. The scientific content, supporting evidence, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged, including the appendices. These edits do not materially improve or diminish the paper's overall quality.
